prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1431; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving through the intersection in League City, heading east on the main road. The light had just turned green for me.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I saw a car coming from the left side just as I got into the middle of the intersection. I tried to brake, but there wasn't enough time.
Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?
A: The driver's side door took the hit. The other car hit me on the side, and my car spun a little before it stopped.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My lower back started hurting almost right away. It's a tight, pulling pain, and it gets worse when I sit for a long time or bend over.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took X-rays, said there were no fractures, and told me I had a back strain. They gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and see a physical therapist.
Q: Are you still receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I have two therapy sessions scheduled each week. I'm also trying to limit lifting at work.
Q: Has anyone else been in your vehicle or spoken to you about how the accident happened?
A: My passenger was a coworker, but she was on her phone and didn't see much. I haven't talked to the other driver since the accident.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm not at fault. I had a green light, and I was already in the intersection when the other car came through its red.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
